description: This file defines the ReminderRegistry class, which manages the registration, unregistration, and retrieval of grain reminders within the Orleans runtime. It interacts with the reminder service through dependency injection and provides methods to ensure proper configuration and context validation.

classes.name: ReminderRegistry
classes.description: Manages grain reminders, providing registration, unregistration, and retrieval functionalities, ensuring proper context and configuration validation.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers or updates a grain reminder with specified due time and period, performing validation on inputs.

methods.name: UnregisterReminder
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered grain reminder.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder by name for a grain.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders associated with a grain.

methods.name: EnsureReminderServiceRegisteredAndInGrainContext
methods.description: Validates whether the reminder service is registered and checks the current context.

methods.name: ValidateServiceProvider
methods.description: Ensures that the service provider has the necessary services configured.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidContext
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating an invalid grain context.
